summary: A named route for NPC patrols. Register it once, with { id, name, points, mode, speed, radius, waitSeconds }, and pass it to npc.patrol as the object, id or name. An NPC copies the route when ordered, so changes or removal affect only patrols started later.

create.exampleLua:
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

local walls = kcds.characters.PatrolRoute.create({ name = "walls", points = { Vector3.new(1650, 2150, 37), Vector3.new(1680, 2150, 37), Vector3.new(1680, 2180, 37) }, mode = "pingPong", speed = "walk", waitSeconds = 5 })
guard:patrol(walls)
create.exampleCs:
var walls = PatrolRoute.Create(new { name = "walls", points = new[] { new Vector3(1650, 2150, 37), new Vector3(1680, 2150, 37), new Vector3(1680, 2180, 37) }, mode = "pingPong", speed = "walk", waitSeconds = 5 });
guard.Patrol(walls);

params.source: A definition, { id?, name?, points, mode?, speed?, radius?, waitSeconds? }, or an array of points.
params.name: Optional: the name, when `source` is an array of points.

getById.summary: The route with this id, or null.
getById.exampleLua:
local route = kcds.characters.PatrolRoute.getById("walls-north")
if route then
  guard:patrol(route)
end

getByName.summary: The route with this name, or null.
getByName.exampleLua:
local route = kcds.characters.PatrolRoute.getByName("walls")
if route then
  guard:patrol(route)
end

all.exampleLua:
for _, route in ipairs(kcds.characters.PatrolRoute.all()) do
  print(route.id, route.name)
end

exists.summary: False once the route has been removed.
exists.exampleLua:
if not route.exists then
  print("the route was removed")
end

id.summary: The route's id, or '' after destroy.

destroy.summary: Removes the route. Running patrols keep their copy.

update.summary: Changes route fields for patrols started from now on.
